name_note: GTDB names this species Hominisplanchenecus faecis, while most of its genomes carry the NCBI name Faecalicatena fissicatena, the name used in the papers cited here.

sentences.text: Faecalicatena fissicatena belongs to the Lachnospiraceae, described as the most common gram-positive bacteria in the gut.
A study of anaerobic riboflavin degradation describes Faecalicatena fissicatena as the only other anaerobe reported to degrade riboflavin.
A comparative study reported Faecalicatena fissicatena among short-chain fatty acid-producing bacteria reduced in a Parkinson's disease-associated microbial signature.
In patients with systemic sclerosis, higher ultra-processed food consumption was associated with a negative coefficient for Faecalicatena fissicatena.
